description: This file is a script that scans project files to identify and inventory web search provider boundaries, especially focusing on import sources, plugin IDs, and provider IDs in the context of a codebase that manages web search providers. It performs file system traversal, parsing, and comparison to build an inventory and verify boundary rules.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories to list all files with specific extensions, respecting ignore rules.

methods.name: compareInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries based on provider, file, line, and reason for sorting.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an inventory entry after validating provider ID.

methods.name: scanWebSearchProviderRegistry
methods.description: Parses lines from the web search provider registry file to identify provider import and registration patterns.

methods.name: scanGenericCoreImports
methods.description: Detects import patterns from other core files not allowed for specific files unless in allowed list.

methods.name: collectWebSearchProviderBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Main function to gather and assemble the inventory of web search provider boundaries across project files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory data.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats inventory data into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runWebSearchProviderBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Executes the boundary check and comparison against baseline.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script, handling exit codes.
